o.text: Internationalism. From Russian октя́брь (oktjábrʹ), ultimately from Latin Octōber.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آرغچ (arġaç), ultimately a derivation from Proto-Turkic *ar- (“weft, woof; warp”), whence also Azerbaijani əriş (“warp”).

From Proto-Turkic *buŕ-, *boŕ- (“to damage, destroy”).
Cognate with Turkish bozmak, Chuvash пӑс (păs, “break, destroy”), etc.
